subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should @agent autocomplete extend the existing Control UI slash/composer and agents.list metadata path, introduce a dedicated agents.directory plus rich-chip editor path, or wait for a broader composer-suggestion design?
rationale: The request adds user-facing composer behavior and possible gateway API surface, while current code already has slash suggestions and agent identity metadata that may be sufficient for a first implementation.

options.title: Scope shared composer suggestions
options.body: Use the current slash-menu/composer path as the starting point and add API surface only after proving agents.list lacks required metadata.

options.title: Approve dedicated mentions API and chips
options.body: Treat agents.directory and rich mention chips as a new Control UI/API direction with accessibility, IME, paste, serialization, and history proof required.

options.title: Defer to broader chat UX planning
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers scope @agent and custom-term autocomplete together with a single suggestion contract.

recommendation.title: Scope shared composer suggestions
recommendation.body: Use the current slash-menu/composer path as the starting point and add API surface only after proving agents.list lacks required metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest adjacent product-triage signal and feature-history connection for shared composer-suggestion direction.
